svg.title: Thashmika Bandara: Engineering ideas into impact
svg.desc: Night scene. Thash stands on a ridge looking over an offshore wind farm whose copper export cable lights up a coastal city. Above, a copper planet orbited by skill planets (Optimisation, Life cycle assessment, Data and ML, IoT, Energy systems), and a constellation of projects shaped like a Pareto front with paretolens at the knee.
